'''''The Maker''''' was a [[YT-1300 light freighter/Legends|YT-1300 light freighter]] that was stolen from [[Sythluss Leethe]] by [[T'Charek Haathi]] and her crew on [[Zelos II]]. It was used by Haathi on missions for the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]].<ref name="Ship Jackers" />

During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], ''The Maker'' landed at an Alliance [[drop point]] on [[Gelgelar/Legends|Gelgelar]] for supplies. While there, the drop point came under attack from an [[Assassin droid/Legends|assassin droid]] that was onboard ''The Maker''. [[Nofre Ecls]] hot-wired the main engine to the powergrid so the disabled freighter could be used for emergency evacuation of the drop point.<ref name="AJ14">{{JournalCite|14|Special Ops: Drop Points}}</ref>

''The Maker'' was equipped with a custom [[Transponder mask/Legends|transponder mask]] that allowed it to use an alternate [[Transponder code/Legends|transponder code]], identifying the vessel as ''One Shot''.<ref name="Ship Jackers" />
